title: Reinforcement Learning Reward Shaping Experiments on LunarLander-v3
excerpt: Comparing four reward-shaping formulations using PPO in Gymnasium with Stable-Baselines3 across 3 seeds and 1M training steps.

blocks.text: Why Reward Shaping Matters in RL

blocks.content: In reinforcement learning, reward design directly determines policy convergence velocity and stability. Naive sparse rewards lead to sample inefficiency, while poorly tuned dense rewards can introduce unintended policy side effects.
Using Gymnasium's LunarLander-v3 and Stable-Baselines3 PPO, we evaluated four distinct reward formulations systematically across 3 seeds for 1,000,000 steps each.

blocks.code:
import gymnasium as gym
from stable_baselines3 import PPO

env = gym.make("LunarLander-v3")
model = PPO("MlpPolicy", env, learning_rate=3e-4, seed=42)

blocks.content: All training logs and evaluation benchmarks are covered by 51 passing unit and regression tests, verifying deterministic seed execution and rollout consistency.
